answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The lantern holds work receipts rather than names, so the bridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
